h1: The 6 Best Mini PC Mounts of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: Best Mini PC Mounts: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: six mini PC mounts compared on device thickness, VESA support, weight limit and mounting location to clear your desk.
summary: The HumanCentric thin client mount is the best overall for VESA and under-desk use. The Adjustable Thin Client mount is the most flexible, the VIVO adds a 3-year warranty, the PUTORSEN holds the heaviest boxes, and the Under Desk 5-Level mount suits thicker PCs.
intro: Mini PCs look tiny until you try to hang one. The common failure is thickness: a mount that grips 2.5 inches will not hold a 3 inch box, and a VESA bracket is useless if your monitor has no matching holes.

We ranked six mounts using spec sheets for adjustable width, weight rating and mounting spots. The order favors fit range and versatility. Check your device's thickness before every purchase, because it decides which mounts are even an option.

products.name: HumanCentric Thin Client Mount Bracket Mini PC VESA Monitor Arm, Under Desk
products.verdict: VESA, wall, under-desk and pole mounting in one bracket.
products.description:
The HumanCentric fits devices 0.65 to 2.55 inches deep and mounts on VESA 75x75 and 100x100, under a desk, on a wall or on a pole. It is rated for an 11 lb device, or 18 lbs combined with a monitor, and includes silicone scratch strips.

It ranks first because it covers the most mounting options, including a combined load rating. The Adjustable Thin Client below is cheaper but has less detail.

Buy it for a standard mini PC. It costs $25-50.
products.idealFor: Standard mini PCs on VESA monitors.
products.skipIf: Your PC is over 2.55 inches thick.

products.name: Adjustable Thin Client Mini PC Mount Bracket (Wall, Under Desk, Monitor Arm)
products.verdict: Four mounting spots and cable management.
products.description:
This metal bracket fits devices 0.63 to 2.8 inches wide and mounts on a wall, under a desk, behind a monitor or on a monitor arm. It is rated for 12 lbs and has built-in cable management and a pen holder.

It ranks second because the width range is wider than the HumanCentric. The listing lacks a stated combined load.

Choose it for tidy cables. It costs under $25.
products.idealFor: Tidy desks with several mounting options.

products.name: VIVO Adjustable Thin Client Mini PC Mount Bracket
products.description:
The VIVO is solid powder-coated steel with an adjustable width of 1.8 to 7.1 cm, VESA 75x75 and 100x100 support, a 5 kg (about 11 lb) weight limit and a 3-year warranty.

It ranks third because the width range is narrower than the first two. The warranty is the longest listed here.

Pick it for a slim thin client. It costs under $25.
products.skipIf: Your PC is thicker than 2.8 inches.

products.name: suptek Thin Client Mount Bracket Adjustable Mini PC Mount
products.verdict: An open frame that keeps air moving.
products.description:
The suptek is solid steel with an adjustable width of 0.6 to 2.7 inches, VESA 75x75 and 100x100 support, an 11 lb weight limit and an open-frame cooling design.

It ranks fourth because it lacks the extras of the first two. The open frame helps a warm PC.

Choose it for a PC that runs warm. It costs under $25.

products.name: Under Desk Mini PC Mount Bracket, 5-Level Height Adjustable
products.verdict: Five height levels from 1.8 to 3.3 inches.
products.description:
This reinforced steel bracket has 5 height levels from 1.8 to 3.3 inches and width-adjustable side brackets. It mounts under a desk only, and comes with screws and a positioning template.

It ranks fifth because it mounts in one place only. It fits thicker boxes than any thin-client mount above.

Buy it for a chunkier mini PC. It costs under $25.
products.idealFor: Thicker mini PCs under a desk.

products.name: PUTORSEN Under Desk Mini PC Mount NAS Mount Bracket Holder
products.verdict: The highest weight rating, at 22 lbs.
products.description:
The PUTORSEN is sturdy steel rated for 22 lbs (10 kg), with 9 height levels from 4.2 to 8.0 inches, under-desk mounting only and a full installation kit.

It ranks last because it suits larger devices and not thin mini PCs. It carries the most weight here.

Pick it for a NAS or a larger box. It costs $25-50.
products.idealFor: NAS boxes and big mini PCs.
products.skipIf: Your PC is a thin client.

whatMatters.detail: Thickness decides if a mount fits at all. Many thin-client brackets grip 0.6 to 2.8 inches. Measure your PC with a ruler and compare it to the range in the listing.
VESA is the standard hole pattern on the back of monitors. 75x75 and 100x100 are the common sizes. Check your monitor's manual before buying a VESA mount.
Most mounts here hold about 11 lbs. A heavier NAS needs a mount rated to 22 lbs. Find the weight limit in the bullets.
Under the desk frees the surface, while behind a monitor hides the box entirely. Pick the spot first, then the mount.
Scratch strips and padding protect the casing. They matter on a nicely finished mini PC. The HumanCentric includes silicone strips.

faq.q: Will a mount fit my mini PC?
faq.a: Measure its thickness and compare it to the mount's range. The HumanCentric covers 0.65 to 2.55 inches.

faq.q: What if my monitor has no VESA holes?
faq.a: Use an under-desk or wall mount instead, such as the Under Desk 5-Level bracket.

faq.q: Is the HumanCentric worth it over the Adjustable Thin Client?
faq.a: If you need VESA and a combined rating, yes. For flexible mounting at lower cost, the Adjustable is enough.

faq.q: How do I install under a desk?
faq.a: Hold the template to the underside, mark the holes and screw in. Check the desk thickness for the screws.
Yes. An open frame like the suptek helps a warm PC.
Use the PUTORSEN, rated to 22 lbs.

finalTake: The HumanCentric Thin Client mount is the best choice for most mini PCs, thanks to VESA support and flexible mounting. The Adjustable Thin Client mount is the best flexible budget pick, and the PUTORSEN is the answer for heavier boxes. Measure thickness before buying any of them.
